reviews.title: It’s 2026 figure out how to make buttons work
reviews.text: Issues playing in background now. Sometimes it is works sometimes it’s just gone. Does skip…skip? It does one of three things skips…yay…changes to the next play list…wtf(and no it’s not the last track)….or greys out… sorry you are listening to this song and all the rest.I don’t want to use my microphone…stop asking it’s music listening app. Now it’s 5+ press to get to my favorites. DJs are sick though keep it up guys.

reviews.title: Fitness class planning
reviews.text: Would like to change tempo of each song and save the edited version needed for a class. Not all the playlist keep the consistent tempo and some you want to switch songs out etc make more editable

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: Another app luring you into the free trial only for them to hope you forget to cancel your membership with at least 24hrs before the billing date. More importantly, the mixes and music were not worth paying a monthly fee for. You can get better hyrox/exercise music on other platforms for free. I don’t recommend it.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your time
reviews.text: Terrible product. After three tries and the music either not playing, or playing multiple songs at once on top of ads, it was completely unusable

reviews.title: Good when it works
reviews.text: App is decent when it works. A lost freezing and hanging. Recently app has been unable to open as it crashes at loading.

reviews.title: Amazing music. Glitchy app.
reviews.text: Absolutely obsessed with the BPM-based running DJ mixes. Has totally transformed my running training. And I use many playlists in the gym as well when I’m lifting or doing MetCon workouts. Unfortunately the app is SO glitchy and it’s so tough so download playlists to my Apple Watch. I have to click sync like 10 times and eventually it sends it to my watch. And when I try to stream them over cellular, they get choppy and start over often. But the mixes are so darn good, I tolerate all the glitches.

reviews.title: Constantly closing the app automatically
reviews.text: The app won’t stay open for more than 10 seconds before closing itself. Have tried reinstalling, even paying. Nothing helps

reviews.title: Bugs
reviews.text: Not sure if it’s the design or a hug but it is very annoying that I cannot lock my phone or else the music stops.

reviews.title: Limits
reviews.text: Recently introduced limits on personal tier were poorly rolled out and the limits themselves don’t work for personal use working out 5+ a week. Love the music, but not sure this was the right way to roll out changes and limits to customers.

reviews.title: Usage Limit
reviews.text: I have been using the app for almost 10 years and never had a limit to my listening, but today it cut off my music and said I had reached my limit of 35 hours for the month. I work out 2-3 hours a day sometimes 4 for 7 days a week. Was never told there was a limit wth is going on, this is bad business and they want almost 60.00 a month for unlimited what happened to being grandfathered in, time for a new app, it has been consistent but not worth that money for mixes to workout to sorry but I am out

reviews.title: Kept crashing
reviews.text: Never opened or was able to hear any of the music just kept crashing as it loaded multiple times. Deleted!

reviews.title: Sound Quality
reviews.text: A 2001 mix from Napster re-recorded 7x in analog 96kbps has better sound quality. Between this and the monthly steaming limit, Fit Radio must be barely surviving if they’re having to depend on these types of cost savings. Cool mixes though.
